name: 黑色月牙天冲
description: 向同一行或同一列的一个方向发射弹射物，对路径上的所有敌人造成200%攻击力的魔法伤害；命中后，可以传送至第一个被命中敌人相邻的一个空格。
targetText: 同一行或同一列的一个方向
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var markerStore = battle.extensions && battle.extensions.ichigoBlackGetsugaTeleportByCaster; if (markerStore) delete markerStore[caster.instanceId]; var targetPos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 99, filter: 'all' }); if (!targetPos || targetPos.needsTargetSelection) return targetPos; var dx = targetPos.x - caster.x; var dy = targetPos.y - caster.y; if ((dx !== 0 && dy !== 0) || (dx === 0 && dy === 0)) return { success: false, message: '黑色月牙天冲只能向同一行或同一列的方向发射' }; var direction = { x: dx === 0 ? 0 : (dx > 0 ? 1 : -1), y: dy === 0 ? 0 : (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1) }; var events = traceProjectile({ x: caster.x, y: caster.y }, direction, { excludePieceId: caster.instanceId }); var enemies = []; var firstPosition = null; for (var i = 0; i < events.length; i++) { var event = events[i]; if (event.type === 'piece' && event.piece.ownerPlayerId !== caster.ownerPlayerId) { enemies.push(event.piece); if (!firstPosition) firstPosition = { x: event.piece.x, y: event.piece.y }; } if (event.type === 'terrain' && event.blocksProjectile) break; } if (enemies.length === 0) return { success: true, message: caster.name + '的黑色月牙天冲未命中敌人' }; var damage = Math.round(caster.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); var result = dealDamage(caster, enemies, damage, 'magical', battle, context.skill.id); var message = caster.name + '的黑色月牙天冲命中' + enemies.length + '名敌人，造成共' + (result.totalDamage || 0) + '点魔法伤害'; if (caster.currentHp <= 0 || !battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === caster.instanceId; })) return { success: true, message: message }; var offsets = [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]; var landings = offsets.map(function(offset) { return { type: 'cell', x: firstPosition.x + offset[0], y: firstPosition.y + offset[1] }; }).filter(function(cell) { var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === cell.x && item.y === cell.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props || !tile.props.walkable) return false; return !battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.x === cell.x && piece.y === cell.y; }); }); if (!landings.length) return { success: true, message: message + '，首个目标附近没有合法空格' }; if (!battle.extensions) battle.extensions = {}; if (!battle.extensions.ichigoBlackGetsugaTeleportByCaster) battle.extensions.ichigoBlackGetsugaTeleportByCaster = {}; battle.extensions.ichigoBlackGetsugaTeleportByCaster[caster.instanceId] = landings; return { success: true, message: message }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { var damage = Math.round((piece.attack || 0) * skillDef.powerMultiplier); return { description: '向直线方向发射弹射物，对路径上的所有敌人造成' + damage + '点魔法伤害；命中后可选择传送落点。', expectedValues: { damage: damage } }; }
